original_text: Demonstrate one bounded, read-only route capability using existing repository mechanisms where possible.
intent: Produce an evidence-backed RDO plan for a small route capability without changing runtime behaviour.
constraints: Reuse existing mechanisms where evidence supports reuse
assumptions: The selected Git snapshot is the intended repository baseline
acceptance_criteria: A durable cycle records the original request and input revision
Every proposed obligation traces to a seed and has explicit evidence needs

seed_obligations.title: Expose the read-only route
seed_obligations.rationale: A route is the requested capability's external interface.
seed_obligations.impact: Without a route the capability cannot be consumed by a client.
evidence_needs: Current route and router registration source anchors
A test or contract establishing read-only response semantics

seed_obligations.title: Determine whether route configuration needs persistence
seed_obligations.rationale: Persistence is required only if the route has durable configuration.
seed_obligations.impact: Without required persistence, configuration may not survive process restart.
evidence_needs: Evidence of an existing persistence mechanism or a reviewed reason it is unnecessary
assumptions: Persistence requirement is not yet established

relationships.note: Investigate configuration persistence before recommending implementation.
